user.title: Pair with the OpenCode beta app
user.description: Enable ha_assist_enabled in the app and open its administrator-only /ha-assist/ Ingress page. Enter the internal URL and pairing key shown there. Requires Home Assistant 2026.10.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew pairing
reauth_confirm.description: Create a new pairing key on the app's /ha-assist/ Ingress page.

error.no_models: Configure an available provider and model in OpenCode first.

user.title: Add a conversation agent

error.unsupported_model: Choose a model with tool support when selecting APIs.
